details:
Example: When moving your hands if front of you, it looks like it's vibrating very quickly between 3 different positions that are millimeters apart. This only happens when you follow your moving hands with your HMD view, and not when you hold your hands still and spin around using the thumbstick on your controller. I show examples of both these situations in the videos posted below.
Reproduce: I tried multiple avatars, both old Avatar SDK and current Avatar SDK, in multiple worlds, both old World SDK and current World SDK. Tried this in standard VRchat, and VRchat beta. I tried with PhysBone conversion on, and off. Also tried with SteamVR motion smoothing on, and SteamVR motion smoothing off.
I made videos of this to show what is happening, but the effect is not as intense or as obvious as viewing it directly from the HMD. In the video it seems to happen intermittently, but while viewing live from the HMD, it's constant and intense. Possibly because OBS studio can only record in 60FPS, while my HMD is running at 90FPS(Hz)
Before this version of VRchat I had never experienced anything like this, even when my frame rate dropped below 90FPS(Hz).
I've tested every other VR game and app that I have, and this effect is not present in them.
VIDEOS: (Watch in 1080p 60fps)
https://youtu.be/pYhu8glBnRM
https://youtu.be/cH_sfWqRshQ
VRchat Version: w_2022.1.2 and w_2022.2.1
System Specs:
HMD: HP Reverb G2(WMR+SteamVR)
GPU: 1070ti
CPU: i7-8700K 3.9GHz
System RAM: 16GB
title: Avatar Dynamics w_2022.1.2 and w_2022.2.1: All avatars in motion vibrate/jitter.
